{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' worked as the producer of the [[Actor/Legends|performer]] [[J'fe Din]]. Together with Din, the producer used the former's [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] series, [[Starflash (holovid series)|''Starflash'']], to surreptitiously convey vital information, such as codes, passwords, and messages, to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents operating in the [[Larrin sector/Legends|Larrin sector]], thereby hastening the collapse of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] by at least a [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="Heroes">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
